trace_server.api_trace.the_op_is_list_ad: The op is list, add, read, judge, note, undo, open, pdf, plan or passages.
trace_server.api_trace.that_pdf_is_over_: That PDF is over 200 MB, so it was not kept.
trace_server.api_trace.that_file_did_not: That file did not arrive whole, so it was not kept.
trace_server.api_trace_project.the_op_is: The op is folder, new, open, read, rename, forget or reveal.
trace_server.new_trace_place.that_folder: That folder holds a Trace project already.
trace_server.said.new_trace_prompt: Choose the folder for the new Trace project.
trace_server.said.trace_not_opened: That Trace project has not been opened yet. Open it from the home screen first.
trace_server.said.trace_not_made: Trace could not write the project, so nothing was made.
trace_server.said.not_kind: Trace takes a manuscript, .md or .docx, or a reference list, .csv, .ris or .bib.
trace_server.said.no_doc: That document is not in this project.
trace_server.said.no_ref: That reference is not in the reference list.
trace_server.said.no_claim: That claim is not in the document.
trace_server.said.no_ref_list: Trace found no reference list in that document. Add the reference list first, a CSV, RIS or BibTeX file, or give the document a heading named References.
trace_server.said.no_list_refs: Trace found no references in that file. A CSV needs a column named Reference, or Author, Year and Title.
trace_server.said.nothing_to_judge: A citation with no reference has nothing to judge against.
trace_server.said.no_pdf: Trace has no PDF of this reference.
trace_server.said.no_cites: The document never cites this reference, so there is nothing to find.
trace_server.said.pdf_unread: Trace could not read the text of this PDF.
trace_server.said.not_pdf: That file is not a PDF, so it was not kept.
trace_server.said.pdf_there: This reference has a PDF already.
trace_server.said.not_a_project: A Trace project's folder holds trace-project.json, and that one does not.
trace_server.said.judge_values: A judgement is Y, Q or N.
trace_server.said.list_gone: The reference list is not there now.
trace_server.read_bytes.file_over_32_mb: That file is over 32 MB, so Trace did not read it.
trace_server.read_bytes.file_not_read: That file could not be read.
trace_server.read_docx.word_file_not_rea: That Word file could not be read.
trace_server.act.judge_or_note: The act is judge or note.
